plugins.photosPermission: Snookered needs access to your videos so you can pick a clip of your practice for the coach to look at.
plugins.cameraPermission: Snookered uses the camera to record practice clips for the coach, and to scan the table so the balls can be put back where they were.
plugins.microphonePermission: Snookered uses the microphone only while you record a practice clip with the camera, because a video recording includes its sound.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Snookered uses your location only when you tap "Use my current location" while setting where you coach, to fill in the club or town for you.

plugins.calendarPermission: Snookered adds a session to your calendar only when you tap "Add to calendar" on a confirmed booking.
